messages:
ellie.wu: quick heads-up: i hit a 404 on the KV cache runbook when previewing canary. image /img/diag/kv-seq.png 404s on staging :grimacing:
assets-bot: automated-scan: 404 at /img/diag/kv-seq.png (scan id 77221)
tom.hendrix: thanks ellie. can you paste the staging URL + a curl snippet?
ellie.wu: staging: https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/kv-patterns
repro: ```
$ curl -I https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/kv-patterns
HTTP/2 200
...
GET /img/diag/kv-seq.png -> 404 Not Found
```
maria.nguyen: owner in CODEOWNERS is @docs-assets. small fix: copy image to /static/diagrams and update markdown link. prefer to do on canary first.
tom.hendrix: i can take this. plan: 1) copy from s3://doc-archive/kv-seq.png -> docs/static/diagrams/kv-seq.png 2) update md link to /static/diagrams/kv-seq.png 3) improve alt text to "KV sequencing overview" and add caption to help search
ellie.wu: tiny ask: include caption text "Shows KV cache sequencing and batch routing" so it's indexable. also lowercase filename please.
tom.hendrix: good call. i'll open a tiny PR to canary and tag @maria.nguyen for review.
assets-bot: scheduled re-scan after PR merge (scan id 77222)
tom.hendrix: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9981 moved asset + updated link + caption. requesting review: @maria.nguyen @ellie.wu
maria.nguyen: quick review 44d small nit: alt text should be "KV cache sequencing (overview)". please run `scripts/release-preview --canary` before merge.
tom.hendrix: adjusted alt text, ran preview; staging render looks good, CI green. merging to canary now.
assets-bot: re-scan complete: /static/diagrams/kv-seq.png reachable (scan id 77223) :white_check_mark:
ellie.wu: thanks! i'll add a note to tomorrow's docs-sprint standup to sweep other /img/diag paths after the recent asset consolidation.
maria.nguyen: adding a short task to the sprint board to catch leftover image paths and to add a lightweight CI grep that flags /img/diag occurrences in markdown."
